modalities.evidence: Functional MRI data were acquired in two runs
EEG recordings organized according to the BIDS specification

output.population: Five healthy human participants, scanned after completing nine sessions of EEG-controlled exoskeleton walking and standing experiments.
output.summary: Multimodal BIDS dataset from five participants performing kinesthetic motor imagery while viewing first-person video of themselves walking in an exoskeleton, including structural MRI, task and baseline fMRI, and EEG recordings.
